title: ITER 真空室與低溫恆溫器
subcategoryTitle: 核融合：工程系統與其他路線
subcategoryTitleEn: Fusion: engineering systems and other approaches
summary: ITER 的電漿在容積約 1,400 m³ 的雙層壁真空室裡，整個真空室與超導磁體又裝在直徑與高度都近 30 m 的低溫恆溫器裡；課程定量分析恆溫器承受的大氣壓力、中子壁負載與核熱、千噸級底座的吊裝、烘烤時的熱膨脹、熱屏蔽的輻射熱負載與真空室的壓力抑制系統。
summaryEn: ITER's plasma lives in a double-walled vacuum vessel of about 1,400 m³, and vessel and superconducting magnets together sit in a cryostat nearly 30 m in diameter and height; the course quantifies atmospheric load on the cryostat, neutron wall loading and nuclear heating, the thousand-tonne base lift, thermal expansion in baking, radiative heat load on thermal shields, and the vessel pressure-suppression system.
scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與標準架構編寫的原創教學。步驟是可驗證的分析、估算與檢核任務，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、運轉程序或作業許可。核能內容僅限公開的熱循環、功能架構、土木與安全理念，不包含燃料製備、濃縮、再處理、武器、反應度整定、反應爐操作或保安細節。數值為公開標稱值或教學假設，實際工程須由合格專業人員依規範與實測資料重新計算並負責。
scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and standards frameworks. Steps are verifiable analysis, estimation and checking tasks, not drawings, method statements, operating procedures or permits. Nuclear content is limited to public thermal cycles, functional architecture, civil works and safety concepts and excludes fuel production, enrichment, reprocessing, weapons, reactivity settings, reactor operation and security details. Numbers are public nominal values or teaching assumptions; real work must be recalculated by qualified professionals using codes and measured data.
v30Focus: 兩層真空邊界：雙層壁真空室、世界最大的不鏽鋼真空容器、熱屏蔽與烘烤
v30FocusEn: Two vacuum boundaries: the double-walled vacuum vessel, the world's largest stainless vacuum chamber, thermal shields and baking

stages.title: 資源、需求與系統架構：ITER 真空室與低溫恆溫器
stages.titleEn: Resource, demand and system architecture: ITER Vacuum Vessel and Cryostat
stages.description: 本階段聚焦「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」與「恆溫器承受的大氣壓力」：先建立機制與定量模型，再設計試驗驗證並診斷失效。
stages.descriptionEn: This stage covers "Device size and plasma volume" and "Atmospheric load on the cryostat": build the mechanism and quantitative model first, then design verification and diagnose failures.

quiz.question: 關於「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Device size and plasma volume" is correct?
options: 托卡馬克的電漿是一個甜甜圈形的環：大半徑 R 是環中心到電漿中心的距離，小半徑 a 是電漿截面的半寬，兩者之比稱為長寬比。
融合裝置做得大只是因為技術還不成熟，將來一定可以縮小到桌面大小。
真空容器裡面沒有壓力，所以殼體不需要很強。
optionsEn: A tokamak plasma is a doughnut-shaped ring: major radius R runs from the centre of the torus to the plasma centre, minor radius a is the half-width of the cross-section, and their ratio is the aspect ratio.
Fusion devices are large only because the technology is immature and will certainly shrink to tabletop size.
A vacuum vessel has no pressure inside, so its shell need not be strong.
quiz.explanation: 托卡馬克的電漿是一個甜甜圈形的環：大半徑 R 是環中心到電漿中心的距離，小半徑 a 是電漿截面的半寬，兩者之比稱為長寬比。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: A tokamak plasma is a doughnut-shaped ring: major radius R runs from the centre of the torus to the plasma centre, minor radius a is the half-width of the cross-section, and their ratio is the aspect ratio. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 裝置尺寸與電漿體積：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Device size and plasma volume: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」如何決定「ITER 真空室與低溫恆溫器」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Device size and plasma volume” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “ITER Vacuum Vessel and Cryostat”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 托卡馬克的電漿是一個甜甜圈形的環：大半徑 R 是環中心到電漿中心的距離，小半徑 a 是電漿截面的半寬，兩者之比稱為長寬比。電漿體積大致與 R·a² 成正比，並因截面拉長而增大。體積越大，表面積對體積的比越小，能量越不容易流失，這是融合裝置必須做得很大的根本原因；球形托卡馬克則以很小的長寬比換取較高的比壓。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: A tokamak plasma is a doughnut-shaped ring: major radius R runs from the centre of the torus to the plasma centre, minor radius a is the half-width of the cross-section, and their ratio is the aspect ratio. Plasma volume scales roughly with R·a² and grows with elongation. A larger volume has a smaller surface-to-volume ratio and loses energy less easily, the basic reason fusion devices must be big; spherical tokamaks trade a very low aspect ratio for higher beta. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：真空室外徑約 19.4 m、高約 11.4 m，內部容積約 1,400 m³
steps.observationEn: Project file: The vacuum vessel is about 19.4 m in outer diameter and 11.4 m tall with an interior of about 1,400 m³
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「融合裝置做得大只是因為技術還不成熟，將來一定可以縮小到桌面大小。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "Fusion devices are large only because the technology is immature and will certainly shrink to tabletop size." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Device size and plasma volume”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: A tokamak plasma is a doughnut-shaped ring: major radius R runs from the centre of the torus to the plasma centre, minor radius a is the half-width of the cross-section, and their ratio is the aspect ratio. Plasma volume scales roughly with R·a² and grows with elongation. A larger volume has a smaller surface-to-volume ratio and loses energy less easily, the basic reason fusion devices must be big; spherical tokamaks trade a very low aspect ratio for higher beta.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：融合裝置做得大只是因為技術還不成熟，將來一定可以縮小到桌面大小。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: Fusion devices are large only because the technology is immature and will certainly shrink to tabletop size. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 真空室外徑約 19.4 m、高約 11.4 m，內部容積約 1,400 m³
knowledge.textEn: The vacuum vessel is about 19.4 m in outer diameter and 11.4 m tall with an interior of about 1,400 m³

quiz.question: 依「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」的模型 V ≈ 2·π²·R·a²·κ，以橢圓截面近似的電漿體積最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model V ≈ 2·π²·R·a²·κ for "Device size and plasma volume", which value is closest to the plasma volume approximated with an elliptical cross-section?
options: 416 m³
832 m³
optionsEn: 416 m³
832 m³
quiz.explanation: V ≈ 2·π²·R·a²·κ；代入 R = 6.2 m、a = 2.0 m、κ = 1.7，得 832 m³（以橢圓截面近似的電漿體積）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: V ≈ 2·π²·R·a²·κ; with R = 6.2 m, a = 2.0 m, κ = 1.7 the result is 832 m³ (plasma volume approximated with an elliptical cross-section). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 裝置尺寸與電漿體積：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Device size and plasma volume: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Device size and plasma volume” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：V ≈ 2·π²·R·a²·κ；代入 R = 6.2 m、a = 2.0 m、κ = 1.7，得 832 m³（以橢圓截面近似的電漿體積）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 a 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: V ≈ 2·π²·R·a²·κ; with R = 6.2 m, a = 2.0 m, κ = 1.7 the result is 832 m³ (plasma volume approximated with an elliptical cross-section). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise a by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：a 增加 10% 時，結果變為 1,007 m³（+21.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising a by 10% changes the result to 1,007 m³ (+21.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 832 m³（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 a 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 832 m³ (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in a with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: V ≈ 2·π²·R·a²·κ；代入 R = 6.2 m、a = 2.0 m、κ = 1.7，得 832 m³（以橢圓截面近似的電漿體積）。
knowledge.textEn: V ≈ 2·π²·R·a²·κ; with R = 6.2 m, a = 2.0 m, κ = 1.7 the result is 832 m³ (plasma volume approximated with an elliptical cross-section).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: a 增加 10% 時，結果變為 1,007 m³（+21.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising a by 10% changes the result to 1,007 m³ (+21.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Device size and plasma volume"?
options: 量測時不必記錄環境溫度、負載與運轉模式，因為它們不影響結果。
金屬加熱一兩百度，尺寸變化小到可以忽略。
由磁診斷重建的平衡（如 EFIT）取得每次放電的實際 R、a、拉長比與體積，並與設計值及真空室限制器位置比對。
optionsEn: Ambient temperature, load and operating mode need not be recorded because they cannot affect the result.
Heating metal by a hundred or two degrees changes its size negligibly.

Take actual R, a, elongation and volume of each discharge from equilibrium reconstruction such as EFIT based on magnetic diagnostics, and compare with design values and limiter positions in the vessel.
quiz.explanation: 由磁診斷重建的平衡（如 EFIT）取得每次放電的實際 R、a、拉長比與體積，並與設計值及真空室限制器位置比對。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: Take actual R, a, elongation and volume of each discharge from equilibrium reconstruction such as EFIT based on magnetic diagnostics, and compare with design values and limiter positions in the vessel. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 裝置尺寸與電漿體積：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Device size and plasma volume: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Device size and plasma volume” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 由磁診斷重建的平衡（如 EFIT）取得每次放電的實際 R、a、拉長比與體積，並與設計值及真空室限制器位置比對。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: Take actual R, a, elongation and volume of each discharge from equilibrium reconstruction such as EFIT based on magnetic diagnostics, and compare with design values and limiter positions in the vessel. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：每次放電的平衡重建結果要與控制系統的即時估算比對並存檔，作為判斷診斷漂移與控制裕度的依據。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Equilibrium reconstructions of each discharge should be compared with real-time control estimates and archived as the basis for judging diagnostic drift and control margin.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：電漿截面拉長可以提高性能，但也使垂直位置不穩定；控制系統反應不及時，電漿會在毫秒內撞向上方或下方的壁面，造成垂直位移事件。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Elongating the cross-section improves performance but makes vertical position unstable; if the control system is too slow the plasma hits the upper or lower wall within milliseconds in a vertical displacement event. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 由磁診斷重建的平衡（如 EFIT）取得每次放電的實際 R、a、拉長比與體積，並與設計值及真空室限制器位置比對。
knowledge.textEn: Take actual R, a, elongation and volume of each discharge from equilibrium reconstruction such as EFIT based on magnetic diagnostics, and compare with design values and limiter positions in the vessel.

knowledge.textEn: Equilibrium reconstructions of each discharge should be compared with real-time control estimates and archived as the basis for judging diagnostic drift and control margin.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：ITER 研究計畫與技術基準文件（公開版）。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: ITER Research Plan and technical baseline documents (public versions). Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Device size and plasma volume" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 電漿截面拉長可以提高性能，但也使垂直位置不穩定；控制系統反應不及時，電漿會在毫秒內撞向上方或下方的壁面，造成垂直位移事件。
所有異常都是操作人員失誤，設計、製造與維護不需要檢討。
真空容器裡面沒有壓力，所以殼體不需要很強。
optionsEn: Elongating the cross-section improves performance but makes vertical position unstable.
Every anomaly is operator error, so design, manufacturing and maintenance never need review.
A vacuum vessel has no pressure inside, so its shell need not be strong.
quiz.explanation: 電漿截面拉長可以提高性能，但也使垂直位置不穩定；控制系統反應不及時，電漿會在毫秒內撞向上方或下方的壁面，造成垂直位移事件。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Elongating the cross-section improves performance but makes vertical position unstable; if the control system is too slow the plasma hits the upper or lower wall within milliseconds in a vertical displacement event. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 裝置尺寸與電漿體積：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Device size and plasma volume: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「裝置尺寸與電漿體積」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Device size and plasma volume” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 電漿截面拉長可以提高性能，但也使垂直位置不穩定；控制系統反應不及時，電漿會在毫秒內撞向上方或下方的壁面，造成垂直位移事件。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「ITER 真空室與低溫恆溫器」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Elongating the cross-section improves performance but makes vertical position unstable; if the control system is too slow the plasma hits the upper or lower wall within milliseconds in a vertical displacement event. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “ITER Vacuum Vessel and Cryostat”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：體積越大，表面積對體積的比越小，能量越不容易流失，這是融合裝置必須做得很大的根本原因；球形托卡馬克則以很小的長寬比換取較高的比壓。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: A larger volume has a smaller surface-to-volume ratio and loses energy less easily, the basic reason fusion devices must be big; spherical tokamaks trade a very low aspect ratio for higher beta.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「融合裝置做得大只是因為技術還不成熟，將來一定可以縮小到桌面大小。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "Fusion devices are large only because the technology is immature and will certainly shrink to tabletop size." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 電漿截面拉長可以提高性能，但也使垂直位置不穩定；控制系統反應不及時，電漿會在毫秒內撞向上方或下方的壁面，造成垂直位移事件。
knowledge.textEn: Elongating the cross-section improves performance but makes vertical position unstable; if the control system is too slow the plasma hits the upper or lower wall within milliseconds in a vertical displacement event.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.

knowledge.title: 工程年表
knowledge.text: 2015：恆溫器組件開始運抵工地

quiz.question: 關於「恆溫器承受的大氣壓力」，下列哪一項敘述正確？
quiz.questionEn: Which statement about "Atmospheric load on the cryostat" is correct?
options: 真空容器裡面沒有壓力，所以殼體不需要很強。
真空室只是一個裝電漿的桶子。
超導磁體必須保持在絕對溫度四度左右，四周若有空氣，熱就會靠對流與傳導不斷湧入。
optionsEn: A vacuum vessel has no pressure inside, so its shell need not be strong.
The vacuum vessel is just a bucket that holds the plasma.
Superconducting magnets must stay near four kelvin, and with air around them heat would pour in by convection and conduction.
quiz.explanation: 超導磁體必須保持在絕對溫度四度左右，四周若有空氣，熱就會靠對流與傳導不斷湧入。 其餘選項是常見誤解。
quiz.explanationEn: Superconducting magnets must stay near four kelvin, and with air around them heat would pour in by convection and conduction. The other options are common misconceptions.

steps.title: 恆溫器承受的大氣壓力：機制與能量路徑
steps.titleEn: Atmospheric load on the cryostat: mechanism and energy path
steps.objective: 說明「恆溫器承受的大氣壓力」如何決定「ITER 真空室與低溫恆溫器」的能量轉換、輸送、儲存或安全功能，並畫出輸入、轉換、損失與系統邊界。
steps.objectiveEn: Explain how “Atmospheric load on the cryostat” governs energy conversion, transfer, storage or safety functions in “ITER Vacuum Vessel and Cryostat”, and map inputs, conversions, losses and the system boundary.
steps.instruction: 超導磁體必須保持在絕對溫度四度左右，四周若有空氣，熱就會靠對流與傳導不斷湧入。低溫恆溫器把整台機器包在一個抽成真空的不鏽鋼圓筒裡，像一個巨大的保溫瓶。真空的代價是外面的大氣會以每平方公尺十噸的力把殼壓向裡面：恆溫器的頂蓋直徑近三十公尺，承受的總力相當於數千噸重。殼體因此要用加勁肋補強，防止它像被踩扁的鋁罐一樣挫屈。 師傅任務：畫出這個單元的能量與物質流圖（輸入、轉換、損失、輸出、邊界），標出哪些量由設計決定、哪些由資源、環境或運轉決定，再用三句話寫出機制摘要。
steps.instructionEn: Superconducting magnets must stay near four kelvin, and with air around them heat would pour in by convection and conduction. The cryostat encloses the whole machine in an evacuated stainless cylinder like a giant vacuum flask. The price of vacuum is that the atmosphere presses the shell inward with ten tonnes on every square metre: the lid is nearly thirty metres across and carries a total force equal to thousands of tonnes of weight. The shell is therefore stiffened with ribs so it does not buckle like a trodden drinks can. Mentor task: draw the energy and material flow of this unit (inputs, conversions, losses, outputs, boundary), mark which quantities are fixed by design and which by resource, environment or operation, then summarise the mechanism in three sentences.
steps.observation: 工程檔案：真空室連同內部組件重約 8,500 噸
steps.observationEn: Project file: The vessel with its in-vessel components weighs about 8,500 t
steps.failure: 常見誤解：「真空容器裡面沒有壓力，所以殼體不需要很強。」這個說法忽略了上述機制；請在流程圖上指出它錯在哪一個環節。
steps.failureEn: Common misconception: "A vacuum vessel has no pressure inside, so its shell need not be strong." It ignores the mechanism above; mark on your flow diagram where it breaks down.
steps.check: 流程圖標明「恆溫器承受的大氣壓力」的輸入、轉換、損失與邊界；三句摘要能解釋本步列出的誤解為何不成立。
steps.checkEn: The flow diagram shows inputs, conversions, losses and boundary for “Atmospheric load on the cryostat”; the three-sentence summary explains why the listed misconception fails.

knowledge.textEn: Superconducting magnets must stay near four kelvin, and with air around them heat would pour in by convection and conduction. The cryostat encloses the whole machine in an evacuated stainless cylinder like a giant vacuum flask. The price of vacuum is that the atmosphere presses the shell inward with ten tonnes on every square metre: the lid is nearly thirty metres across and carries a total force equal to thousands of tonnes of weight. The shell is therefore stiffened with ribs so it does not buckle like a trodden drinks can.

knowledge.title: 誤解辨析
knowledge.text: 誤解：真空容器裡面沒有壓力，所以殼體不需要很強。 正確的工程判斷必須回到機制與量級。
knowledge.textEn: Misconception: A vacuum vessel has no pressure inside, so its shell need not be strong. Sound engineering judgement goes back to mechanism and magnitude.

knowledge.title: 工程檔案
knowledge.text: 真空室連同內部組件重約 8,500 噸

quiz.question: 依「恆溫器承受的大氣壓力」的模型 F = p·π·r²，大氣壓 101.3 kPa 作用在半徑 14.5 m 的頂蓋上的總力最接近下列何者？
quiz.questionEn: Using the model F = p·π·r² for "Atmospheric load on the cryostat", which value is closest to the total force of 101.3 kPa of atmospheric pressure on a lid of 14.5 m radius?
options: 669 MN
optionsEn: 669 MN
quiz.explanation: F = p·π·r²；代入 p = 101.3 kPa、r = 14.5 m，得 66.9 MN（大氣壓 101.3 kPa 作用在半徑 14.5 m 的頂蓋上的總力）。 其餘選項是倍數或數量級錯誤。
quiz.explanationEn: F = p·π·r²; with p = 101.3 kPa, r = 14.5 m the result is 66.9 MN (total force of 101.3 kPa of atmospheric pressure on a lid of 14.5 m radius). The other options are factor or order-of-magnitude errors.

steps.title: 恆溫器承受的大氣壓力：定量估算
steps.titleEn: Atmospheric load on the cryostat: quantitative estimate
steps.objective: 以數值模型估算「恆溫器承受的大氣壓力」的關鍵量，並判斷輸入改變時結果的方向與幅度。
steps.objectiveEn: Estimate the key quantity of “Atmospheric load on the cryostat” with a numerical model and judge the direction and size of change when an input moves.
steps.instruction: 依下列模型逐步重算：F = p·π·r²；代入 p = 101.3 kPa、r = 14.5 m，得 66.9 MN（大氣壓 101.3 kPa 作用在半徑 14.5 m 的頂蓋上的總力）。 師傅任務：保留單位重算一次；再把 r 增加 10%，先預測再計算輸出，說明它是線性、平方或更高次方的關係，並指出設計或規範通常如何處理這個敏感度。
steps.instructionEn: Recalculate step by step: F = p·π·r²; with p = 101.3 kPa, r = 14.5 m the result is 66.9 MN (total force of 101.3 kPa of atmospheric pressure on a lid of 14.5 m radius). Mentor task: redo the calculation keeping units; then raise r by 10%, predict before computing the output, state whether the dependence is linear, quadratic or steeper, and note how designers or codes usually handle this sensitivity.
steps.observation: 敏感度核對：r 增加 10% 時，結果變為 81.0 MN（+21.0%）。
steps.observationEn: Sensitivity check: Raising r by 10% changes the result to 81.0 MN (+21.0%).
steps.failure: 計算陷阱：單位換算錯誤、把教學假設當成實機設計值、混淆額定值與實際運轉值，或只看結果不檢查數量級，都會讓後續判斷失準。
steps.failureEn: Calculation traps: unit slips, treating teaching assumptions as plant design values, mixing rated and actual operating values, or accepting a result without checking its magnitude will mislead later decisions.
steps.check: 重現 66.9 MN（取整誤差 ±2% 內），並提交 r 改變 10% 的敏感度計算與工程解釋。
steps.checkEn: Reproduce 66.9 MN (within ±2% rounding) and submit the sensitivity calculation for a 10% change in r with an engineering explanation.

knowledge.title: 定量模型
knowledge.text: F = p·π·r²；代入 p = 101.3 kPa、r = 14.5 m，得 66.9 MN（大氣壓 101.3 kPa 作用在半徑 14.5 m 的頂蓋上的總力）。
knowledge.textEn: F = p·π·r²; with p = 101.3 kPa, r = 14.5 m the result is 66.9 MN (total force of 101.3 kPa of atmospheric pressure on a lid of 14.5 m radius).

knowledge.title: 敏感度
knowledge.text: r 增加 10% 時，結果變為 81.0 MN（+21.0%）。 先預測方向與次方，再用計算確認。
knowledge.textEn: Raising r by 10% changes the result to 81.0 MN (+21.0%). Predict direction and exponent first, then confirm by calculation.

knowledge.title: 模型邊界
knowledge.text: 本步數值為公開標稱值或教學假設的簡化；套用到實際設備前，必須依規範、製造商資料與現場量測重新計算。
knowledge.textEn: These numbers are public nominal values or simplified teaching assumptions; before applying them to real equipment, recalculate with codes, manufacturer data and site measurements.

quiz.question: 要驗證「恆溫器承受的大氣壓力」，下列哪一個做法最恰當？
quiz.questionEn: Which approach best verifies "Atmospheric load on the cryostat"?
options: 沿用另一座電廠或另一台機組的試驗結果，就可視為本工程已完成驗證。
抽真空時以位移計與應變計量測殼體的變形並與挫屈分析比較，並以氦質譜檢漏儀檢查所有現場銲道。
真空只要用夠大的泵抽久一點就會變好。
optionsEn: Reusing test results from another plant or unit counts as verifying this project.
During pump-down displacement and strain gauges measure shell deformation against buckling analysis, and every site weld is checked with a helium mass-spectrometer leak detector.
Vacuum simply improves if a big enough pump runs long enough.
quiz.explanation: 抽真空時以位移計與應變計量測殼體的變形並與挫屈分析比較，並以氦質譜檢漏儀檢查所有現場銲道。 驗證需要基準、重複性與事先訂定的允收準則。
quiz.explanationEn: During pump-down displacement and strain gauges measure shell deformation against buckling analysis, and every site weld is checked with a helium mass-spectrometer leak detector. Verification needs a baseline, repeatability and acceptance criteria fixed in advance.

steps.title: 恆溫器承受的大氣壓力：試驗與驗證
steps.titleEn: Atmospheric load on the cryostat: testing and verification
steps.objective: 設計一項可重複的試驗、量測或檢查，驗證「恆溫器承受的大氣壓力」是否符合模型與規範預期，並在量測前訂出允收準則與停留點。
steps.objectiveEn: Design a repeatable test, measurement or inspection that verifies whether “Atmospheric load on the cryostat” meets the model and code expectation, fixing acceptance criteria and hold points before measuring.
steps.instruction: 抽真空時以位移計與應變計量測殼體的變形並與挫屈分析比較，並以氦質譜檢漏儀檢查所有現場銲道。 師傅任務：把上述方法寫成試驗或量測計畫，列出儀器、基準或校正、步驟、比較對象、允收準則與停留點，並估計三項主要不確定度來源。
steps.instructionEn: During pump-down displacement and strain gauges measure shell deformation against buckling analysis, and every site weld is checked with a helium mass-spectrometer leak detector. Mentor task: turn this into a test or measurement plan listing instruments, baseline or calibration, procedure, comparison, acceptance criteria and hold points, and estimate the three largest uncertainty contributions.
steps.observation: 現場實務：外壓容器要以實測的幾何缺陷做挫屈驗算，並在首次抽真空時分段停留量測。
steps.observationEn: Site practice: Check buckling of an externally pressurised vessel with measured geometric imperfections, and pause in stages for measurement during the first pump-down.
steps.failure: 注意干擾：殼體的初始不圓度或銲接變形會大幅降低挫屈強度；現場銲接的品質若不一致，真空下的變形超出預期。 只量一次、沒有可追溯的基準，或不記錄環境與運轉條件，就無法分辨真正的偏差與量測誤差。
steps.failureEn: Watch for interference: Initial out-of-roundness or weld distortion lowers buckling strength greatly, and with uneven site-weld quality deformation under vacuum exceeds prediction. A single reading, no traceable baseline, or unrecorded ambient and operating conditions make real deviations indistinguishable from measurement error.
steps.check: 提交試驗或量測計畫：儀器、基準、步驟、允收準則、停留點與不確定度預算，並說明如何判定合格、由誰簽認。
steps.checkEn: Submit the test or measurement plan: instruments, baseline, procedure, acceptance criteria, hold points and uncertainty budget, with the pass/fail rule and who signs it off.

knowledge.title: 驗證方法
knowledge.text: 抽真空時以位移計與應變計量測殼體的變形並與挫屈分析比較，並以氦質譜檢漏儀檢查所有現場銲道。
knowledge.textEn: During pump-down displacement and strain gauges measure shell deformation against buckling analysis, and every site weld is checked with a helium mass-spectrometer leak detector.

knowledge.title: 現場實務
knowledge.text: 外壓容器要以實測的幾何缺陷做挫屈驗算，並在首次抽真空時分段停留量測。
knowledge.textEn: Check buckling of an externally pressurised vessel with measured geometric imperfections, and pause in stages for measurement during the first pump-down.

knowledge.title: 規範與標準
knowledge.text: 可對照的公開規範或指引：IAEA 融合設施安全相關技術文件。引用時須確認版次與適用範圍。
knowledge.textEn: A public code or guide to compare against: IAEA technical documents on safety of fusion facilities. Confirm edition and applicability before citing it.

quiz.question: 在「恆溫器承受的大氣壓力」出現異常時，下列哪一項判斷最合理？
quiz.questionEn: When "Atmospheric load on the cryostat" shows an anomaly, which diagnosis is most reasonable?
options: 把警報門檻調寬，就能解決大多數異常。
真空室只是一個裝電漿的桶子。
殼體的初始不圓度或銲接變形會大幅降低挫屈強度；現場銲接的品質若不一致，真空下的變形超出預期。
optionsEn: Widening the alarm thresholds resolves most anomalies.
The vacuum vessel is just a bucket that holds the plasma.
Initial out-of-roundness or weld distortion lowers buckling strength greatly, and with uneven site-weld quality deformation under vacuum exceeds prediction.
quiz.explanation: 殼體的初始不圓度或銲接變形會大幅降低挫屈強度；現場銲接的品質若不一致，真空下的變形超出預期。 需以量測區分可能原因。
quiz.explanationEn: Initial out-of-roundness or weld distortion lowers buckling strength greatly, and with uneven site-weld quality deformation under vacuum exceeds prediction. Discriminate candidate causes by measurement.

steps.title: 恆溫器承受的大氣壓力：失效診斷
steps.titleEn: Atmospheric load on the cryostat: failure diagnosis
steps.objective: 從症狀倒推「恆溫器承受的大氣壓力」的失效或劣化原因，提出能區分原因的檢查、矯正與預防措施。
steps.objectiveEn: Work back from symptoms to the failure or degradation causes of “Atmospheric load on the cryostat” and propose discriminating checks, corrective actions and prevention.
steps.instruction: 殼體的初始不圓度或銲接變形會大幅降低挫屈強度；現場銲接的品質若不一致，真空下的變形超出預期。 師傅任務：建立失效樹——症狀、兩個以上可能原因、能區分它們的量測或檢查，以及矯正與預防措施；並說明此失效如何影響「ITER 真空室與低溫恆溫器」的安全、出力、壽命或併網。
steps.instructionEn: Initial out-of-roundness or weld distortion lowers buckling strength greatly, and with uneven site-weld quality deformation under vacuum exceeds prediction. Mentor task: build a fault tree with the symptom, at least two candidate causes, a measurement or inspection that tells them apart, and corrective and preventive actions; explain how the failure affects safety, output, life or grid connection of “ITER Vacuum Vessel and Cryostat”.
steps.observation: 連結機制：殼體因此要用加勁肋補強，防止它像被踩扁的鋁罐一樣挫屈。
steps.observationEn: Link to the mechanism: The shell is therefore stiffened with ribs so it does not buckle like a trodden drinks can.
steps.failure: 誤判風險：若相信「真空容器裡面沒有壓力，所以殼體不需要很強。」，上述症狀可能被錯誤處理而反覆出現。
steps.failureEn: Misdiagnosis risk: believing "A vacuum vessel has no pressure inside, so its shell need not be strong." leads to mishandling the symptom so it keeps returning.
steps.check: 完成失效樹與矯正措施，指出哪一項量測或檢查能最快確認根因、需要哪些人簽認，以及如何防止再發。
steps.checkEn: Complete the fault tree and corrective actions, name the measurement or inspection that confirms the root cause fastest, who must sign off, and how recurrence is prevented.

knowledge.title: 失效模式
knowledge.text: 殼體的初始不圓度或銲接變形會大幅降低挫屈強度；現場銲接的品質若不一致，真空下的變形超出預期。
knowledge.textEn: Initial out-of-roundness or weld distortion lowers buckling strength greatly, and with uneven site-weld quality deformation under vacuum exceeds prediction.

knowledge.title: 根因確認
knowledge.text: 根因必須以可區分的量測或檢查確認；只更換設備、重設警報或放寬允收值可能掩蓋問題。
knowledge.textEn: Confirm the root cause with a discriminating measurement or inspection; swapping equipment, resetting alarms or relaxing limits can mask the problem.
